spans.s: ? abhauti-, in Laṅk 〔17.5〕, text abhauti-bhautikānām; Suzuki things created and uncreated; the mss. are very confused; some simply abhautikānāṃ; perhaps read [] abhautika-bhaut˚ (and perhaps render rather of things non-elemental and elemental). Surely no stem abhauti should be recognized. See bhautika (2); one possible reading for the above passage might be bhūta-bhautikānām, of gross elements and (subsidiary elements or) sense-objects.
